technique_name: Compare and contrast the philosophies of utilitarianism and Kantianism.
description: Utilitarianism is a moral philosophy that holds that the best moral action is the one that produces the greatest amount of good for the greatest number of people. This requires weighing the value of a certain action against its consequences, in order to determine if the good it produces outweighs the costs.
